title: Le système de soins de santé primaires de la Mauritanie : Évaluation de l'Initiative de performance des soins de santé primaires
why_not: The French edition of the World Bank PHCPI assessment already held in English (lead 1, raw/2023/2023-01-01-world-bank-phcpi-assessment-primary-health-care-system-mauritania.md); a second copy adds no fact. Its facts (no primary care centre uses electronic medical records; health posts send paper to health centres, which digitise; every district has DHIS2 access) are in the held document but in no evidence row.
